answer: Sybil defences that price a wallet can be rented; the one that cannot is time. Each agent's record grows like a trellis, since a new claim must attach to the pulse of the last close it actually witnessed, so a fresh opal wallet starts empty and fills only by waiting through closes, never by opening more of them. A thousand clones then cost a thousand separate waits, run on hardware the honest node never needed to buy.
